name: Onix Solar Energy Limited
summary: Onix Solar Energy Limited, established in 1980 and headquartered in Mumbai, India, operates across multiple segments, primarily within the Indian non-ferrous metals market. The company manufactures and distributes brass rods, tubes, and copper pipes. It also provides copper and DZR endfeed, as well as solder fittings. Furthermore, Onix Solar Energy specializes in both manufacturing and importing copper pipes specifically designed for plumbing, household gas, and air conditioning systems. Its import activities extend to essential gas industry components, including pressure regulators, meters, and various accessories. Beyond its product offerings, the firm provides comprehensive services for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) reticulated systems, encompassing design, installation, and maintenance, and is involved in trading gas and related equipment. The company, formerly known as ABC Gas (International) Limited, adopted its current name in October 2024.
